death.attack.ascension_atmosphere.no_oxy: %1$s ran out of air while fighting %2$s
block.ascension_atmosphere.air_dispenser: Liquid O2 %1$s / %2$s mB — holding %3$s blocks (needs %4$s mB/s)
Keeps a sealed room breathable while it has Liquid O2.
Feed it by pipe from an Air Compressor. Holds 1 mB a second per 16 blocks of room. Right-click to see its level.
Close every gap in the room: one hole and the air is lost.

item.ascension_atmosphere.oxygen_tank.hi: Use to open or close the valve; use on a player to share air
